title: StudySync Core ELA, Grade 7
edition: 2019-2021 national edition (Reading & Writing Companion printings 2020/2021; reviewed by EdReports as StudySync ELA 2021)

sources.what: McGraw Hill "StudySync ELA Grade Level Overview, Grade 7" PDF (2019), hosted by Montgomery County Public Schools: unit titles, essential questions, genre focus, every unit text, Extended Writing Project prompts, writing and grammar skills
EdReports review of StudySync ELA 2021, Grade 7, Gateway One: confirms the same six units and texts for the 2021 edition
retailer listing confirming ISBN 9781944695798 = Grade 7 Unit 1 "Conflicts and Clashes" Reading & Writing Companion (BookheadEd, 2021)

summary: Grade 7 of McGraw Hill's StudySync Core ELA: six thematic units, each with an essential question and genre focus, built from full texts and excerpts across fiction, poetry, drama, argument and informational writing. Each unit closes with an Extended Writing or Oral Project: narrative, literary analysis, argument, informative, research and an argumentative presentation.

toc.label: Unit 1
toc.title: Conflicts and Clashes
toc.covers: Essential question "When do differences become conflicts?"; genre focus fiction, from fable-like stories to a teleplay and a graphic novel; Extended Writing Project is a narrative about conflict in a world where people can read each other's thoughts; grammar: basic spelling rules I, main and subordinate clauses, simple and compound sentences.

toc.title: Highs and Lows

notes: ISBN 9781944695798 is the Grade 7 Unit 1 Reading & Writing Companion, "Conflicts and Clashes" (AbeBooks listing). Each unit is printed as its own consumable Reading & Writing Companion volume (Unit 1 to Unit 6, per the retailer listings); the digital platform carries further texts, Blasts, StudySyncTV episodes and English Language Learner resources (general). Every unit ends in an Extended Writing Project (one unit per grade uses an Extended Oral Project instead) taught through Plan, Draft, Revise, Edit and Publish steps (page). Texts listed here are the unit selections named in the McGraw Hill Grade Level Overview; several are excerpts from full-length books, and some (marked Independent Read in the program) are read without full lesson support. The Overview spells Unit 4 both "Moment of Truth" and "The Moment of Truth".
